verifier.hypothesisNotClaim: 898/899 and 620 are clone readings. Nothing here is a claim about the source site: no source-site session was used in this batch.

detail.relationTo683: 683 measured the same 132 across 12 heights at 2 widths; this batch adds 6 fresh widths x 2 heights and 981 dense widths.

the-control-population-is-132-on-both-ax.note: the layout neither adds nor removes a control on either axis

detail.whyItMatters: 132 is the CENSUS population, not the number of controls on the canvas. The census filters an element's OWN display, and a control inside a display:none ancestor still reports display:flex -- so it lands in the count with a zero rect.
detail.correctionTo683: 683's reading ('the two zero-sized controls are constant') holds on the height axis; what was wrong is the CATEGORY. They are not rendered-and-squeezed, they are not-rendered. 623's comment already recorded this for the rail.

the-census-counts-controls-that-are-not-.note: 'zero-sized' is one bucket holding at least two different causes -- 671's blind spot, one level deeper

detail.whyComplementary: one container is min-[899px]:flex and the other is max-[899px]:flex, so the controls that vanish at one side appear at the other -- the zero population EXCHANGES, it does not shrink or grow

the-zero-population-is-a-two-sided-excha.note: 623 recorded that pair as a one-pixel seam and fixed it; the two sides are exactly complementary today

detail.theirComputedWidth: 0 — the used width really is zero, and no ancestor is display:none
detail.vsTheOtherNine: the other nine have a computed width of 32px and a zero rect, which is the signature of a display:none ancestor
detail.sourceFact: they are the object-name spans inside the 220px narrow track list (DirectorTimeline.tsx:1598 `w-[320px] shrink-0 ... max-[899px]:w-[220px]`)

the-only-genuinely-zero-sized-controls-a.note: third state kept separate from the measured value, per the ledger rule

detail.sourceFact: DirectorDesk.tsx:392 uses matchMedia('(max-width: 898px)') -- 622 aligned the JS to the CSS. '(max-width: 899px)' survives only in comments, and at exactly vw=899 it reports true while the rail is already the desktop 48x668 box.
detail.notABug: nothing in the shipped code queries the 899 spelling; this is a trap that is still copyable, not a live defect

the-seam-is-898-899-with-no-layover-and-.note: 623 fixed the min-[900px]/min-[899px] gap; this re-measures that it held

detail.whyOneDecreaseMatters: the import series has exactly ONE decrease and it is the 620 discontinuity. Everywhere else it only rises, so the rounded census's '8px dent' is a rounding band, not a shape in the layout.

theSoCalledDentBand.verdict: the census reads a constant 31 across 620..627, but the used width is strictly increasing there. The band is the rounding of a ramp, not a layout event.
theSoCalledDentBand.gridNote: getComputedStyle returns FOUR decimals, not the exact 1/64 value, so the grid is asserted with a tolerance of 1e-2 in 1/64 units (= 0.00016px). 30.7656px is 1969/64 to within the returned precision.

capture.verdict: a single ramp over 35 consecutive pixel widths, read by the census as a 1px-per-pixel staircase

detail.theHeadlineOfThisBatch: the most striking reading of the first pass -- 'a non-monotonic 8px dent' -- was produced entirely by the ruler. The real shape is one ramp plus one discontinuity (check 7).

rounding-manufactures-plateaus-out-of-re.note: this is the second instrument defect of this batch, and it has the same shape as the first: what I got was not the layout, it was the ruler

detail.sourceFact: DirectorDesk.tsx:1072 -- the sibling `data-director-capture-status` carries `max-[620px]:hidden`, i.e. it becomes a flex item at vw=620. A sibling APPEARING makes this button NARROWER, because the row is fully shrinkable.
detail.so: the axis has two seams, not one, and the second produces a discontinuity rather than a plateau band

the-second-breakpoint-is-a-discontinuity.note: a 1.23px drop is invisible to a census that rounds to integers

detail.exportIsWrapped: DirectorDesk.tsx:1122 puts export inside `<div class="relative">`; a block wrapper with min-width:auto cannot shrink below its min-content, so the button is rigid
detail.importIsBare: DirectorDesk.tsx:1128 puts import directly in the shrinkable right cell; it has flex-shrink:1 and no shrink-0, so it absorbs the deficit continuously
detail.status: this is the batch's only candidate defect. The fix would be `shrink-0`, which is a change to src/ -- a product decision, not taken here.

two-nominally-identical-icon-buttons-beh.note: 'the button is a fixed 32px' is true for one of the two and false for the other
